verdict.rationale: Clerky documents online completion and submission of IRS forms, which plausibly covers 83(b) filings, though 83(b) is never named. It also documents formation document sets that bundle documents, signatures, and filings, plus a dashboard for additional legal paperwork. Founder stock purchase agreements and IP assignment are not explicitly evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit founder stock purchase paperwork, IP/technology assignment documents, named 83(b) election support, independent hands-on corroboration of the post-incorporation founder workflow.

support.subject: As a founder, I can complete post-incorporation setup — founder stock purchases, IP assignment, and 83(b) elections — with correct standard paperwork

citations.quote: Use Clerky to complete IRS forms and submit them to the IRS, completely online. No need for a fax machine.
Forming a startup on Clerky enables access to a legal dashboard that makes it easy to do additional legal paperwork.
It bundles the documents, signatures, and filings for one entity formation.
Clerky gives me management tools (including the post-incorporation package: Fundraising, Hiring and Maintenance)
